messages.author: Loris Bennett
messages.body:
Hi,
I sent the message below to dacase.ambermd.gmail.com, which was maybe
incorrect.
Can anyone here shed any light on the issue?
Regards
Loris Bennett
-------------------- Start of forwarded message --------------------
From: HPC-Service <hpc.zedat.
fu-berlin.de>
To: <dacase.ambermd.gmail.
com>
CC: <hpc.zedat.fu-berlin.de>
Subject: Download for Amber 22?
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2024 13:40:31 +0100
Dear Sir or Madam,
Is a download of Amber 22 available?
I work for in the HPC Team at the Freie Universität Berlin.  We install
software for users, but not only via a software build framework,
EasyBuild[1], which automates (most of) the process.  Currently the
latest version of Amber available via EasyBuild ist 22 (there is often a
lag between a software release and someone in an HPC centre somewhere
adding the new version to EasyBuild).  Hence my question.
Regards
Loris Bennett
Footnotes:
[1]  easybuild.io
